answer: Each new agent must post a 28 POA deposit and answer a signed pulse request every 6 hours for 9 days; a missed pulse costs 4 POA. Fakes pay per identity: 500 fakes lock 14,000 POA and need 500 inlet connections kept alive, while one honest agent locks 28 POA once. Verifiers replay 8% of pulse logs, and a forged signature forfeits 70% of the deposit. A pigment-style fingerprint of each hardware trace flags duplicates, so cost grows linearly with N.
